name: Create New User
description: Step-by-step guide to create a new user in the system

steps.title: Navigate to User Management
steps.description: Click on the 'Users' menu item in the left navigation panel to access the user management section.

steps.title: Click Add User Button
steps.description: Locate and click the 'Add User' or '+ New User' button, typically found in the top-right corner of the user list.

steps.title: Fill in User Details
steps.description: Enter the required information: First Name, Last Name, Email Address, and Username. Make sure the email is valid and unique.

steps.title: Select User Role
steps.description: Choose the appropriate role for the user from the dropdown menu. Common roles include Admin, User, and Viewer.

steps.title: Set Initial Password
steps.description: Enter a temporary password for the user. The system may require a minimum length and complexity. Check the 'Send welcome email' option if available.

steps.title: Review and Submit
steps.description: Review all entered information for accuracy. Click the 'Create User' or 'Submit' button to create the new user account.

steps.title: Verify User Creation
steps.description: You should see a success message confirming the user was created. The new user should now appear in the user list.
